revision_history.reason: Initial proposal generation based on GPT's recommendation for a controlled, 30-post technical cadence on X.

intent: Determine which technical domain (Technical governance, Local LLM engineering, Recovery architecture, Educational robotics) generates the highest sustained engagement on X under a highly controlled 30-post cadence.
hypothesis: A controlled, fixed-cadence posting strategy isolating four distinct technical variables over 30 posts will reveal statistically significant differences in audience engagement, identifying which domain resonates most strongly with the target X audience.

experimental_design.cadence: 1 post per day at 9:00 AM PST

phases.calibration: Days 1-7 (disregarded for final analysis to allow algorithmic baseline)

experimental_design.control: One variable changed at a time, fixed posting time, and rigidly standardized formatting.

substantive_responses.definition: Replies containing technical questions, follow-on insights, or direct project links.

contextual_denominators.definition: Contextual metrics to normalize the response rate and allow future comparative analysis.

metrics.success_criteria: A topic is considered meaningfully stronger only if its substantive response rate exceeds the second-best category by at least 20% over at least 5 posts during the analysis phase.

target.community: AI/ML practitioners, local LLM engineers, automation developers

limitations: The X algorithm is opaque and subject to unannounced changes.
Early posts may suffer from artificially low impressions until the algorithm calibrates to the account's technical niche.
Cross-pollination between topics is inevitable (e.g., a follower gained from Experiment B may engage with Experiment C).
